stories.title: Massive fire breaks out at tyre factory in Firozabad:Flames visible from 5 km away, nearby houses evacuated as smoke makes breathing difficult
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out at a factory extracting oil from tyres in Firozabad. Flames 30–40 feet high erupted due to the tyres and oil, while a huge plume of smoke was visible from nearly 5 km away. The fire quickly went out of control. The 30 workers at the factory managed to escape. Police and fire brigade teams reached the spot and evacuated the surrounding area. Breathing became difficult due to the smoke. Firefighters wore masks while trying to bring the blaze under control. Police have barricaded the area around the factory. To prevent the fire from spreading, three JCB machines are being used to remove tyres from the factory premises and nearby areas. Twelve fire tenders are engaged in firefighting operations. Around 60 tonnes of tyres have been reduced to ashes in the fire. The extent of the damage has not yet been assessed. The incident took place at around 3 pm on Sunday in Uramura Kirar village. See four photos of the incident... Fire spread rapidly due to tyres stored at the factory The fire spread rapidly due to the large quantity of old tyres and other flammable materials stored at the factory. Shikohabad Fire Brigade in-charge and Chief Fire Officer Satyendra Pandey are present at the spot. Fire brigade teams are continuously working to douse the flames. The cause of the fire and the extent of the damage have not yet been assessed. According to local residents, a similar massive fire had broken out at the factory earlier as well. Despite this, the latest incident has raised questions over the fire safety arrangements at the factory. Tyre factory spread across 5 bighas An SBL tyre factory has been operating for the past five years in Uramura Kirar village, around 25 km from the district headquarters. Its owner, Basu Agarwal, is a resident of Vrindavan. The factory is spread across 5 bighas of land, around 600 metres from Shikohabad village. A similar fire broke out at the factory in 2025 as well. 300 tonnes of tyres stored near the site The fire first broke out on Sunday in a section covered with tin sheets, where tyres were being burnt in machines to extract oil. Around 300 tonnes of tyres were stored about 500 metres away from this section. Had the fire reached the tyres, it could have caused a much bigger accident. 30 workers were inside, 60 tonnes of tyres burnt Around 30 workers were present at the factory when the fire broke out. The factory had around 400 tonnes of old tyres, of which nearly 60 tonnes were destroyed in the fire. The extent of the damage has not yet been assessed. The oil extracted by burning tyres is sent outside the factory and is used in road construction. CFO Satyendra Pandey said, “We received information about the fire at around 2:30 pm. The cause of the fire is not yet clear. The pump at the site where the fire broke out has stopped working, so water is not available. There have been no casualties so far. The initial suspicion is that tyres were being burnt in a machine when a spark may have caused the fire.”

stories.title: 'They may kill me, ₹1 cr contract put out':Jitendra Narayan says, 'Plot to appease Muslims underway'; left Islam in 2021
stories.summary: Former Uttar Pradesh Shia Central Waqf Board chairman Wasim Rizvi has expressed apprehension that he may be murdered. Rizvi has converted his religion and is now known as Jitendra Narayan Singh Sengar. In a video, he alleged that a contract has already been given for his murder and that he is being watched round the clock. Sengar claims that he has received highly credible information from his sources. A ₹1 crore contract has allegedly been given to a notorious criminal lodged in Tihar Jail to murder him while he is in police custody or being produced in court. 'The building where I live is being surveilled with cameras installed' Sengar further said that secret cameras had been installed in the building where they live to record every movement of him and the security personnel. He said all this was being done to spread fear among former Muslims and appease extremists. Letter Sent to CM Yogi and the Home Ministry Given the seriousness of the matter, Sengar has written to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, the Union Home Ministry and the Uttar Pradesh Home Department. Sengar claims that he also shared the names of the conspirators and inputs about the terrorist networks linked to them in the letter. He has urged the authorities to investigate the matter and take concrete action soon, otherwise his life could be at risk before the election. Left Islam in 2021 Lucknow resident Wasim Rizvi served as the chairman of the Uttar Pradesh Shia Central Waqf Board for a long time. In December 2021, he renounced Islam and converted to Hinduism at the Dasna Devi Temple in Ghaziabad. He then changed his name to Jitendra Narayan Singh Tyagi, which he later changed to Jitendra Narayan Singh Sengar. Had earlier claimed threat to his life Since his conversion, Sengar has repeatedly been embroiled in controversies over his statements and for speaking out against alleged irregularities in waqf properties. This is not the first time he has claimed that his life is under threat. In December 2025, it was also claimed that he had been attacked in Lucknow's Saadatganj, after which he wrote to the Prime Minister seeking security.

stories.title: Wife catches businessman husband with girlfriend in Meerut:Woman clung to bonnet as he drove 100 metres, then beat him and tore his clothes
stories.summary: In Meerut, a woman became furious after spotting her husband in a car with another woman. When her husband tried to drive away, she lay on the bonnet of the car. Despite this, he did not stop and drove for nearly 100 metres with his wife on the bonnet. The woman kept screaming, “Save me…” Hearing the commotion, passers-by tried to stop the car. As soon as it stopped, the wife assaulted her husband in the middle of the road and even tore his clothes. Meanwhile, the other woman sitting in the car fled the spot. However, police later detained the husband and his alleged lover. A video of the incident has surfaced. The incident took place late Saturday evening in the Lohianagar police station area. Watch 2 pictures... Husband drove for 100 metres while wife clung to the bonnet Mayank, a resident of Hasanpur Kala in Kithore, was travelling in a car with a woman. Near the L-Block police post on Hapur Road, his wife spotted the car. She ran towards it, shouting, but Mayank sped away. The wife climbed onto the bonnet of the car, but he did not stop and continued driving for around 100 metres with her on the bonnet. People riding behind them on motorcycles raised an alarm and tried to stop the car. Mayank eventually stopped the car about 100 metres ahead. Police reached the spot after being informed about the commotion and took both sides to the police station. The wife filed a case against her husband and his alleged lover, accusing them of attempting to kill her. Meanwhile, someone recorded a video of the incident and shared it on social media. Couple had been married for 12 years Mayank got married in 2014, 12 years ago. The couple has two sons. Mayank used to run a shop in Central Market. Due to disputes with his wife, he had been living separately from her for the past three years. He had been staying at home since action was taken against shops in Central Market. While running his shop, Mayank met a woman who works for an insurance company. She had divorced her husband six years ago and has a child. Since Mayank had also been living separately from his wife for three years, the two grew closer. Woman also assaulted husband at petrol pump Another video of the woman, recorded before the bonnet incident, has surfaced. It shows her husband getting fuel filled in his car at a petrol pump, while a young woman is sitting inside the car. As Mayank drove away from the petrol pump, his wife arrived in front of the car on a scooter with a man. She parked the scooter and assaulted her husband and the alleged woman. CO Kotwali Sangram Singh said, Accused Mayank tried to run his car over his wife with the intention of killing her. Taking cognisance of the matter, a case has been registered. The husband and his alleged lover have been detained. The car used in the incident has also been seized. Further legal action is being taken in the case.

stories.title: Akhilesh says, 'Battle is not about seat numbers':Says amid Congress seat-sharing tussle, 'Alliance’s victory should remain main goal'
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav has said that the focus of the alliance with the Congress should be on winning the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections rather than on the number of seats each party gets. His remarks came amid reports of growing differences between the two parties over seat-sharing for the upcoming elections. ‘It is about victory, not seats’ Akhilesh posted on X at around 10 am on Sunday, saying, “It is not about seats, it is about victory. The fight is not over how many seats each party will get, but about ensuring the alliance’s victory.” He later elaborated on his post, saying that when the objective is clear, working together becomes easier. He wrote that the important issue was not how many seats the alliance would contest or which party would get a particular seat, but ensuring that the alliance wins. Akhilesh said the victory would not belong to any one political party but would represent the success of a shared struggle on the ground. He said the objective was to stop communalism, protect the Constitution, democracy and reservation from what he described as the “BJP’s heat”, and promote social harmony. SP wants tickets for candidates who can win There have been reports of differences between the SP and Congress over seat-sharing in recent days. The Congress is seeking a larger share of seats for the upcoming election and has been putting pressure on the SP. The SP, however, believes that the strength of a candidate on a particular seat matters more than the total number of seats allocated to each party. Its focus is on identifying which candidate is capable of defeating the BJP. Political observers believe Akhilesh has stepped in personally to manage the situation. His statement indicates that the SP is willing to accommodate its alliance partner, but wants the focus to remain on winnable candidates. Akhilesh has previously said on several occasions that tickets should go only to candidates capable of defeating the BJP. Three political messages in Akhilesh’s statement Political analysts see the post as more than a routine statement and believe it carries three key messages. 1. Psychological pressure on Congress By placing “victory” above the number of seats, Akhilesh has put the onus on the Congress. Any insistence on a larger number of seats could now be portrayed as weakening the alliance. The SP is seeking to project itself as willing to compromise, provided the Congress takes a practical approach. 2. The ‘winnable candidate’ formula The SP has made it clear that it does not want to distribute seats merely for the sake of seat-sharing. If the Congress has a weak organisational base on a particular seat, the SP is reluctant to give it up. This approach could strengthen the SP’s claim over seats where its cadre is stronger. 3. Focus on Constitution and PDA Akhilesh has continued to focus on the Constitution, democracy, reservation and social harmony. He also wants to retain the party’s PDA — backward classes, Dalits and minorities — narrative and its “Jai Samvidhan” messaging. His strategy is to present the ideological battle against the BJP as more important than the arithmetic of seat-sharing. BJP calls SP-Congress alliance ‘Lathbandhan’ BJP state spokesperson Rakesh Tripathi hit back at Akhilesh’s statement, calling the SP-Congress alliance a “Lathbandhan”. He said the alliance had effectively become a “Lathbandhan”, with leaders of both parties attacking each other through public statements. The BJP spokesperson claimed that relations between the two parties had deteriorated and that even direct communication between them had stopped, forcing Akhilesh to advise his alliance partners through social media. He alleged that both the SP and Congress were acting out of arrogance, with leaders of each party trying to show the other its “place”.

stories.summary: A road accident in Lucknow on Sunday morning claimed the lives of a police sub-inspector’s mother and uncle. The sub-inspector and the car driver were also injured. Sub-inspector Sonu Nigam, posted at Nahtaur police station in Bijnor district, was travelling from Bulandshahr to Lucknow in an XUV300 when the accident occurred. See the pictures- Car overturns several times after hitting pole The accident took place on the Outer Ring Road in Kakori. The car hit a pole, overturned several times and eventually came to a stop. Nigam’s mother and uncle were seriously injured in the accident and died at the spot. Nigam and the driver also suffered injuries. Sub-inspector was travelling to Lucknow for two reasons Nigam was travelling to Lucknow to attend a programme in Mohanlalganj and to arrange treatment for his uncle. Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the accident.

stories.title: ‘Dad, you won’t have to pay anyone now’:Father spent 3 days persuading son; software engineer jumps from UP’s tallest building
stories.summary: A 29-year-old software engineer, identified as Sambhav Jain, died by suicide after jumping from the 43rd floor of a building in Noida on Saturday. Before taking the extreme step, Sambhav sent a message to his father saying, “Papa, you won’t have to pay anyone now.” Police said an examination of his mobile phone showed that he had been in continuous contact with his father on WhatsApp before his death. His father repeatedly tried to persuade him to return home and urged him not to take any such step. However, Sambhav did not respond to his pleas. The incident took place at Aspire Tower in the Supernova society in Sector 94. First, take a look at four pictures of the incident... Within seconds, the young man removed his hand from the railing and fell to the ground below. AC technicians tried to stop him Police said AC technicians working in a nearby room noticed Sambhav on the balcony and tried to persuade him to come back. Sambhav told them that he was under severe depression and did not want to live. He then jumped from the building. WhatsApp messages and video mention financial problems Police found that Sambhav had exchanged messages with his father in both Hindi and English. The messages reportedly referred to his intention to end his life and mentioned financial difficulties. Police have preserved the mobile phone and WhatsApp conversations as part of the investigation. A video of around two minutes was also recovered from Sambhav’s phone. Police said it was recorded before the incident and showed him referring to his financial difficulties. He did not hold anyone responsible for his death in the video. CCTV footage from check-in to room preserved Following the incident, Sector 126 Police examined CCTV footage from the building and surrounding areas. Police have preserved footage showing Sambhav checking into Supernova and going to his room. Technicians and hotel staff who were present at the time were also questioned. The mobile phone, WhatsApp conversations with his father, the video and CCTV footage have been included in the investigation as electronic evidence. Engineer had been staying at Supernova for two days According to police, Sambhav, son of Vinay Kumar Jain and a resident of the IMT Manesar area of Gurugram, had rented room number 4228 at the building on October 2. He checked in at around 2.30 pm. At around 11.27 am on Saturday, he went to the balcony and climbed over the railing. AC technicians working in the adjoining room, 4227, noticed him and came outside. They tried to persuade him to return to safety. Sambhav told them he was severely depressed and did not want to live. He then let go of the railing. Police from Sector 126 reached the spot after being informed and began an investigation. His body was sent for post-mortem examination. Family spent up to ₹40 lakh on treatment of sick child Sambhav had reportedly been under considerable stress for several days. According to his family, he got married in 2024. His child was born prematurely in 2025 and had been unwell since birth. The family spent around ₹35 lakh to ₹40 lakh on the child’s treatment, but the child’s health continued to remain poor. Sambhav later divorced his wife through court proceedings. He was also reportedly concerned about his own health. His family said these issues had left him under considerable stress and that he had not returned home for three days. His father tried to persuade him to come back, but he did not agree. Three earlier deaths reported at Supernova Supernova has witnessed other deaths involving falls from the building in recent years. On January 21, 2023, 43-year-old property consultant Rohit Kumar from Rani Bagh, Delhi, died after falling from the building’s 43rd floor. Police had suspected suicide at the time. In June 2023, 23-year-old engineer Arjun Aloysius from Ernakulam, Kerala, died after falling from the 35th floor. In August 2025, the body of Ravi Sharma, the son of a retired IRS officer, was found on the Supernova premises. Preliminary investigation suggested that he may have fallen from the 32nd floor.

stories.title: Missing 16-year-old boy from Hathras found in Barsana:Family said he had gone to Premanand Maharaj’s Ashram and did not return
stories.summary: A 16-year-old boy from Hathras who had been missing for around three months was found at Ladli Ashram near Barsana temple in Mathura on Saturday. Police were taking the boy, Anuj, back to his village, Baramai Kheda. His family members were accompanying him. First, look at the pictures... Family had staged seven-hour protest outside Ashram Anuj’s family had been searching for him for three months. On Friday, his father Rajveer Singh, along with Anuj’s mother, brother and four sisters, staged a seven-hour protest outside Sant Premanand Maharaj’s ashram from 11 am. The family had alleged that Anuj had gone to the ashram to take initiation and disappeared from there. After the protest ended, Rajveer said police had shown him a photograph of his son, but he had not yet met him. Mathura City SP Rajiv Kumar Singh said the Hathras Police had been searching for the boy with the help of his mobile phone location and CCTV footage. Father said Anuj started visiting Ashram while visiting maternal grandparents Rajveer said he was a farmer and Anuj was his only son among four daughters. The boy was studying in Class 12. Anuj’s maternal grandparents live in Panigaon near Vrindavan, and he often visited them. During these visits, he started going to the Keli Kunj Ashram. Later, he decided to take initiation. Boy left home with prayer beads and three books Rajveer said Anuj had taken initiation from Premanand Maharaj around three months ago after convincing his mother. He stayed at home for five days after the initiation. He later told his family that he was going to meet the spiritual leader. He left home carrying the prayer beads given to him by Premanand Maharaj and three books. He did not return home for the next three months. Grandmother alleged ashram staff pushed family out Anuj’s grandmother, Munni, alleged that three months had passed since his initiation on June 25. She said he had visited the Keli Kunj Ashram again a few months ago, after which the family received no information about him. She alleged that when the family visited the ashram to enquire about him, the people there did not listen to them and pushed them out. The family also asked to see CCTV footage from the Ashram but alleged that they were not allowed to check the recordings. Police found no evidence that boy stayed at Ashram Vrindavan Police reached the ashram after being informed about the family’s protest. Vrindavan CO Sandeep Singh and Kotwali in-charge Ashwani Kumar spoke to the family and gathered details about the case. Police later entered the ashram and made enquiries about Anuj. CO Sandeep Singh said the investigation found that Anuj had taken initiation at the ashram on June 26, 2026. However, there was no information to establish that he had stayed at any of the ashram’s kunjs afterwards. The family had filed an FIR at Sadabad police station on July 5. According to the complaint, Anuj had left home saying he was going to attend coaching classes but did not return. On Friday, his family travelled to Vrindavan and alleged that he was still at the ashram and that the ashram authorities were not properly briefing them about him.

stories.title: 4 die as ambulance carrying soldier’s body crashes into truck:Son, brother and nephew among victims; vehicle en route from Panchkula to Deoria
stories.summary: Four people died in Sultanpur while transporting the body of a soldier. The deceased include the soldier’s only son, his brother, a relative’s son and the ambulance driver. The ambulance, travelling at around 100 kmph, rammed into a truck parked on the side of the expressway. The impact was so severe that the ambulance was completely mangled and its cabin was crushed. The driver’s body became trapped in the steering wheel. Police teams that reached the spot had to cut open the ambulance to rescue the victims. Two bodies that were badly trapped in the front seats were pulled out. Two people sitting in the rear were taken to hospital, where they later died during treatment. According to police, the accident took place around 8:15 am on Sunday on the Purvanchal Expressway near Haliyapur, close to the Ayodhya border. The family was travelling from Panchkula (Chandigarh) to Deoria in an ambulance carrying the body of Subedar Satyawan. The deceased have been identified as Gaurav Singh (18), the only son of Subedar Major Satyawan; his brother Ram Samujh (55); his relative’s son Rajan Singh (35); and ambulance driver Jaspal. The mortal remains of Subedar Major Satyawan have been kept at Haliyapur police station. After receiving information about the accident, District Magistrate Indrajeet Singh and Superintendent of Police Vineet Jaiswal reached the spot. On seeing the DM, the deceased soldier’s nephew broke down and hugged him. The DM put his hand on his shoulder and consoled him. See the pictures- Know the full story… According to police, Army Subedar Major Satyawan, a resident of Rudrapur in Deoria, was posted in Meerut. He had undergone a kidney transplant in Chandigarh. He died in Panchkula three days ago. His family travelled to Panchkula to bring back his body. According to the family, Satyawan’s brother Ram Samujh, relative’s son Rajan Singh and only son Gaurav Singh left for Deoria in an ambulance carrying his body at around 4 pm on Saturday. Satyawan’s wife Sarojini Singh and daughter Diksha were also travelling with the body in an Army vehicle. The Army vehicle moved ahead on the way, so the mother and daughter reached home earlier. Ambulance completely mangled in crash At around 8:15 am on Sunday, the ambulance rammed into a stationary truck from behind on the Purvanchal Expressway in Haliyapur, near the Ayodhya-Sultanpur border. The accident took place near milestone 79.6 km. The impact was so severe that the ambulance was completely mangled and its cabin was crushed. Gaurav Singh, who was seated in the front, and ambulance driver Jaspal were badly trapped in the steering area. After receiving information from passers-by, police reached the spot. The ambulance was cut open to pull out both bodies. They were sent to Sultanpur District Hospital for post-mortem. Ram Samujh and Rajan Singh, who were seated in the rear of the ambulance, were also seriously injured. Both died while undergoing treatment at a government hospital in Ayodhya. Police sent their bodies to Ayodhya District Hospital for post-mortem. Soldier Satyawan Singh’s family lived in Chandigarh Subedar Major Satyawan Singh’s wife, Sarojini Singh, daughter Diksha and son Gaurav Singh lived in Chandigarh. Diksha was pursuing a BTech degree in Chandigarh, while Gaurav Singh was preparing for the NEET entrance exam. Satyawan’s elder brother, Ram Samujh Singh, worked as a postman. He was known as “Bade Babu” in the family. He is survived by his wife, Sheila Devi, and three sons Vivek, Vikas and Vishal. Rajam Chaudhary, the brother-in-law of Ram Samujh’s eldest son Vivek, was a councillor from Bhartoli ward in Rudrapur. Rajan is survived by his wife, Pratibha, and their one-year-old daughter. Nephew broke down and hugged the DM After learning about the deaths of four family members, nephew Daroga Singh could not hold back his tears. While informing DM Indrajeet Singh about the incident, he broke down and hugged him. The DM placed his hand on his shoulder and consoled him. Route was changed after ambulance driver suggested a shortcut Speaking about the cause of the accident and the choice of route, Daroga Singh said, “The family members had left in two vehicles. I was travelling in an Ertiga car and was ahead of the ambulance. I had asked ambulance driver Jaspal to follow me. However, Jaspal suggested taking the Purvanchal Expressway. “According to Daroga Singh, the driver said the expressway would be a shortcut and they would reach sooner. The ambulance then turned onto the expressway. While the other family members travelling in the car reached safely, those travelling in the ambulance lost their lives.” Nephew said, 'What will we tell aunt?' While speaking to the media on the premises of a police station in Sultanpur, Daroga Singh repeatedly broke down in tears. He kept saying, “What will we tell aunt? All the key members of the family are gone in a single blow. There is no one left to support us.” Sultanpur DM Indrajeet Singh said, Subedar Satyabhan Singh was a resident of Deoria. He was undergoing treatment at the Command Hospital in Chandigarh. He had undergone a kidney transplant. He died three days ago. Three members of his family, along with the driver, died in the accident. CCTV footage from the surrounding area is being examined SP Vineet Jaiswal said, “We received information about the accident through Dial 112. Police are taking further action.”

stories.title: Jackson from US immerses uncle’s ashes at Kashi’s Assi Ghat:Says, 'He frequently appeared in dreams, learnt about significance of 'Pind Daan' in Kashi over phone'
stories.summary: A devotee from Michigan, US, travelled to Varanasi with the ashes of his late uncle, Net, and performed Asthi Visarjan (immersion of ashes) and Pind Daan at the famous Assi Ghat. The religious rituals were performed according to Hindu traditions for the peace of his uncle’s soul. Jackson became emotional during the ceremony. Had a close bond with uncle since childhood Jackson said he had lived with his uncle Net since childhood and shared a close emotional bond with him. He said he continued to remember his uncle even after his death. According to Jackson, he frequently saw his uncle in his dreams after his death and became disturbed by the recurring dreams. He then began looking for a way to find peace. During this time, he came across a video about Kashi and the religious rituals performed there. The video explained the religious significance of Kashi and rituals such as asthi visarjan and pind daan. Jackson then decided to travel to Kashi himself to fulfil what he believed was his uncle’s final wish. Ashes immersed amid Vedic chants at Assi Ghat Jackson travelled to Varanasi carrying his uncle’s ashes. The asthi visarjan and pind daan rituals were performed at Assi Ghat under the guidance of pilgrimage priest Rahul Pandey. The rituals were conducted amid Vedic chants, following Hindu religious customs. Jackson then immersed his uncle’s ashes in the Ganga. He became emotional during the ceremony and prayed for his uncle’s soul to attain peace. He also took part in the pind daan rituals with devotion. Priest explains significance of pind daan in Kashi Pilgrimage priest Rahul Pandey said Kashi and the Ganga hold special significance in Sanatan tradition. According to religious beliefs, asthi visarjan and pind daan in Kashi are performed with the hope of bringing peace to the departed soul and attaining Moksha. The traditions of pind daan and tarpan have been followed for centuries as a way of expressing respect and faith towards ancestors.

stories.title: Several Gorakhpur-Mumbai trains to remain diverted in October:Kasara third-line work affects services; check trains and timetable
stories.summary: The operation of several trains between Gorakhpur and Mumbai will be affected in October due to the construction of a third railway line at Kasara station on the Kalyan-Igatpuri section of Central Railway's Mumbai Division. Due to traffic and power blocks, several trains travelling from Gorakhpur to Mumbai and Mumbai to Gorakhpur will be regulated and diverted. The departure timings of some trains will also be changed. The impact will be greatest on Gorakhpur-Mumbai trains operating between October 14 and 17. Due to the diverted routes, several trains will not halt at stations including Nashik Road, Igatpuri, Kalyan and Manmad. Several Gorakhpur-Mumbai trains to run via diverted routes on October 16 15018 Gorakhpur-Lokmanya Tilak Terminus Express will run via Jalgaon-Nandurbar-Vasai Road-Thane on October 16. It will not halt at Pachora, Chalisgaon, Nandgaon, Manmad, Lasalgaon, Nashik Road, Igatpuri and Kalyan. Similarly, 22537 Gorakhpur-Lokmanya Tilak Terminus Express will also run via Jalgaon-Nandurbar-Vasai Road-Thane on October 16. It will skip halts at Pachora, Chalisgaon, Nandgaon, Manmad, Nashik Road, Igatpuri and Kalyan. Meanwhile, 12166 Gorakhpur-Lokmanya Tilak Terminus Express will operate via Manmad-Pune-Lonavala-Kalyan on October 16. It will not halt at Manmad, Nashik Road and Kalyan. 15066 Panvel-Gorakhpur Express to also run on diverted route 15066 Panvel-Gorakhpur Express will travel to Gorakhpur via Thane-Vasai Road-Nandurbar-Jalgaon on October 17. It will not halt at Kalyan and Nashik Road. Besides, 11047 Dadar-Gorakhpur Express will run via Kalyan-Karjat-Pune-Manmad on October 15 and 17. It will skip its halt at Nashik Road. Timings of Mumbai-Gorakhpur trains also changed 22538 Lokmanya Tilak Terminus-Gorakhpur Express will depart 3 hours 55 minutes later than scheduled on October 9, at 4:30 am. On October 18, it will be rescheduled by 2 hours 10 minutes and depart at 2:45 am. On October 21, 22 and 23, it will be rescheduled by 2 hours 55 minutes and depart at 3:30 am. 11081 Lokmanya Tilak Terminus-Gorakhpur Express will depart 1 hour 15 minutes late on October 14, at 5:50 pm. 11079 Lokmanya Tilak Terminus-Gorakhpur Express will also be rescheduled by 1 hour 50 minutes on October 14 and depart at 5:35 pm. 01079 Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus-Gorakhpur Express will depart 1 hour 30 minutes late on October 17. Its revised departure time will be 12:01 am. Gorakhpur-Mumbai trains to be regulated According to the railway authorities, 11080 Gorakhpur-Lokmanya Tilak Terminus Express, 11060 Chhapra-Lokmanya Tilak Terminus Express and 15018 Gorakhpur-Lokmanya Tilak Terminus Express will be regulated by 20 minutes in the Mumbai Division and 25 minutes in the Bhusawal Division on October 10. 12166 Gorakhpur-Lokmanya Tilak Terminus Express will be regulated at Igatpuri station by 1 hour 35 minutes on October 6 and 9, and by 1 hour 15 minutes on October 13. The railway administration has advised passengers to check their train's scheduled departure time and route before travelling.

stories.summary: Fajullaganj in Lucknow is facing severe flooding after water suddenly entered the area. More than 40,000 homes have been affected, impacting nearly 3 lakh people. Over 10,000 residents have reportedly left the area. While floodwater has spread across the locality, residents are struggling to get drinking water. The administration says around 40 boats have been deployed for rescue and relief operations. However, residents claim only a few boats are actually operating. They also allege that thieves are using the boats to reach abandoned houses, break locks and steal valuables after residents leave the area. A Dainik Bhaskar drone captured the extent of the flooding and the situation on the ground in Fajullaganj. Click above to watch the VIDEO...

stories.title: Congress names candidates for 3 Maharashtra MLC seats
Aradhana Misra says removing Ajay Rai is part of strategy:‘Challenges come with responsibilities, I am not afraid’
stories.summary: The newly appointed Uttar Pradesh Congress president, Aradhana Misra ‘Mona’, spoke openly about the party’s priorities for the 2027 Assembly elections, its alliance with the Samajwadi Party, women’s political participation and the Brahmin and upper-caste vote. On Ajay Rai, she said, Removing someone from a post and bringing someone else in… this can be part of the strategy. He is a strong soldier of the Congress. On giving tickets to women, Aradhana cited the Congress’ decision to give 40% of its tickets to women in 2022. Challenging the BJP, she said the party did not want to implement the women’s reservation Bill. ‘If that is not the case, then they should give at least 33% of the tickets to women in the UP elections,’ she said. Read the full interview… Question: You are a prominent Brahmin face in UP. How do you see Brahmins' position within the BJP? Answer: The BJP has always treated Brahmins, Dalits and backward classes merely as vote banks. It took their votes but did not respect them. In contrast, the Congress has never made any caste an issue in politics. From the freedom struggle to this day, our ideology of taking everyone along has not changed. Look at our team in UP; you can see representation from all sections. The Congress is ready to take everyone along in Uttar Pradesh. Question: Upper castes are considered the BJP’s core vote base. How will you bring them to your side? Answer: This is a very sensible section. When the time comes, they make their decision very carefully. So, let the time come. Question: Are Ajay Rai’s supporters unhappy? Answer: Look, removing someone, appointing someone else… this can be part of the party’s strategy. Therefore, the post is not important. The organisation comes first. I am in the post today; tomorrow I may not be there and someone else will be. The party worker will remain there. Whoever leads, workers are the most important for strengthening the organisation. Question: You have limited time and there are several internal differences within the party. How will you deal with them? Answer: There is never a shortage of time; things happen at the right time. After 2024, our organisation has become stronger. You will see the result in 2027. Responsibilities come with challenges. I am not afraid of them. Congress workers will accept the challenge and overcome it. Question: Congress did not perform particularly well in the previous Assembly elections. Where do you see the party in 2027? Answer: Priyanka Gandhi took charge of Uttar Pradesh in 2019. She worked very hard and built the organisation at the block and booth levels. Although the results were not very good in 2022, the organisation that had been built showed its impact in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. The BJP thought it would win all 80 seats in UP. But what happened? The Congress and Samajwadi Party fought so strongly that if the BJP’s chariot of arrogance was stopped anywhere, it was stopped in UP. The INDIA bloc stopped it. The BJP’s government at the Centre is dependent on crutches, with Chandrababu Naidu on one side and Nitish on the other. We are confident that the INDIA bloc will form the government in UP in 2027. Question: The BJP is making efforts to unite women. Has the Congress given you the responsibility for this? Answer: The slogan in 2022 was ‘Ladki hoon, lad sakti hoon’. We ensured women’s political participation by giving 40% of the tickets to women. I challenge them: today, they have a double-engine government and, in some places, a triple-engine government. They should give 33% of the tickets to women. You passed the 33% women’s reservation Bill, but your intention was never to implement it. The Congress has never made women’s empowerment a part of politics. The country’s first woman Prime Minister was Indira Gandhi. The first woman President, Pratibha Patil, was also from the Congress. So, the women of India, the half of the population, will understand that the Congress does not just make promises; it delivers. Question: Will the Congress give 33% of its tickets to women in the election? Answer: We have already given 40% of the tickets to women. If BJP leaders have any moral standing, they should do the same. Giving representation to women is not a political agenda for us; it is our ideology. Question: You have had good political relations with Akhilesh Yadav, while Imran Masood has had strained relations with him. How will you maintain a balance between the two? Answer: On the floor of the House, the Samajwadi Party and Congress have been fighting together under the INDIA bloc since 2023. We have to corner the government and a strategy is formulated for that. Under that strategy, we have challenged the government. While challenging the government in the Assembly, I have presented the Congress’ side. I can give a complete guarantee that I have fulfilled the responsibility assigned to me. Question: The Congress is in an alliance with the Samajwadi Party. How many seats will the Congress contest? Answer: Look, I want to make it clear that the INDIA alliance was not formed at the state level. It was formed at the national level. The central leadership took the decisions regarding all the parties that were part of it. Everyone saw that, just a few days ago, all the national-level leaders were present at the meeting. So, how long will the alliance continue? How many seats will we contest? The national leadership will decide. I will certainly tell the leadership about the sentiments of Congress workers in UP when that decision is taken. Question: There is talk of a Muslim-Dalit-Brahmin alliance. Is the Congress returning to its old formula? Answer: People from every caste and religion are associated with the Congress. Through the UP team, it has been made clear that we will take everyone along and fulfil the mission for 2027. Question: What is so special about Rampur Khas? What is happening on this seat that the Congress has not been able to achieve across UP? Answer: This seat itself is our family. The voters there are our family. We have never allowed the Congress flag to bow. Question: When will the alliance with the SP be announced? Answer: Very soon. We all want a decision to be taken so that we can get down to preparing for the elections. Question: You have been given a major responsibility in UP. What will your priorities be? Answer: The responsibility is big. Our family has a four-generation history of serving the Congress party, and I have to carry this legacy forward. My priority is to strengthen the faith of every Congress worker in Uttar Pradesh whose father was a freedom fighter and who today wants to protect the Constitution and democracy. Question: You started as a block pramukh and then became an MLA three times. Now the Congress has made you its state president. How do you see this journey? Answer: I am grateful to the central leadership, especially Priyanka Gandhi, with whom I have worked for a long time. I first became a BDC member, then contested the block pramukh election. Later, in the 2014 by-election, when my father went to the Rajya Sabha, I represented Rampur Khas. The party gave me a ticket three times and I won each time. I was made the CLP leader twice. It is also a coincidence that my father was the CLP leader 22 times. I got the opportunity to hold that position. Today, once again, the party has placed its trust in me and my family.

stories.title: Aparna’s claim for 3 Lucknow seats gains ground:Why Mulayam’s younger daughter-in-law said she won’t contest Mainpuri, leaves ticket decision to BJP
stories.summary: Mulayam Singh Yadav’s daughter-in-law, Aparna Yadav, may contest the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Speaking in Saifai, Mainpuri, she said, I am fully prepared. I do not wish to contest from Mainpuri. The BJP will decide which Assembly constituency I will contest from. According to BJP sources, she may stake her claim to three seats in Lucknow. However, the BJP organisation could make a major political move by fielding her from a Yadav-dominated seat to make inroads into the Samajwadi Party’s vote bank. The seat could be in Etawah, Kannauj or around Mainpuri. How much could the BJP benefit from Aparna entering the electoral fray? Which seats could she stake her claim to? After her defeat in 2017, what are her chances of winning? Read all this in today’s Sunday Big Story… Why the BJP may give Aparna Yadav a ticket Three Lucknow seats where she may stake her claim Aparna’s politics has largely revolved around Lucknow. Even after being appointed vice-chairperson of the State Women’s Commission, she remained more active in Lucknow. Therefore, it is believed that she could seek a ticket from a seat in the state capital. Three such seats are being considered: New equations: Brajesh Pathak may leave Cantt seat Senior Lucknow journalist Alok Pathak says, If Aparna has said that she will contest the election, it is a clear indication that she has already discussed it with party leaders. There is also news that she could contest from Lucknow Cantt. The current MLA from here, Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak, could contest from Lucknow East or Bakshi Ka Talab. That is why he has also been speaking Bhojpuri in recent days, as this kind of language has an influence in both these seats. As far as Aparna is concerned, I would say that the BJP has, on several occasions, fielded candidates despite setting aside caste and win-loss equations, and helped them win. Three challenges Aparna faces in the race for a ticket ‘Aparna has indicated that she will not go against the family’ Senior journalist Harshvardhan Tripathi says, The BJP has no shortage of leaders in Lucknow. There are already 10 contenders for every seat here. It can be said that it will be difficult for Aparna to get a ticket from here. When Aparna joined the BJP, it was said that she would target the Mulayam family, but that did not happen. She has now said that she does not want to contest from Mainpuri, which means she will not go against her family. Aparna’s political journey in the BJP

Friend killed over Ludo loss:Repeatedly stabbed in stomach, chest with scissors in Lucknow; brother says police did not call ambulance
stories.summary: A 32-year-old man was killed in a fight while playing Ludo in Lucknow. His friend repeatedly attacked him with scissors on the abdomen and chest. They fled, leaving him covered in blood. A shopkeeper informed the police about the incident. Family members took the man to hospital in an auto-rickshaw, where doctors declared him dead. The man's maternal cousin said that if the police had taken him to hospital in time, his brother could have been saved. The incident took place under Purnia bridge in Aliganj at 6 p.m. on Saturday. Eyewitnesses said they were also drinking alcohol Eyewitness Salim said: Some young men were playing Ludo under the flyover. They were also drinking alcohol at the time. An argument broke out among them, which escalated into a fight. Three or four of those involved then fled the scene. A young man was seen lying there covered in blood. The police were then informed. I could not find out anything else. He brought scissors from a pavement massage shop According to information received from the police, Rahul was playing Ludo with his associate Pradeep and some others. When an argument broke out, Pradeep brought a pair of scissors from a pavement massage shop. He stabbed Rahul several times in the chest and abdomen with the scissors. After Rahul was left unconscious and covered in blood in the attack, Pradeep fled the scene. On receiving the information, the police arrived and informed the family. The attacker, Pradeep, lives near a poultry farm close to Madiyaon bridge. The site of the incident is on the border of the Aliganj and Madiyaon police station areas. Police from both stations reached the spot after the incident. ACP Shashi Prakash Mishra visited the site and investigated. Brother said-police personnel merely watched the situation In a press note, the police said they immediately took the injured Rahul Awasthi to Wagha Hospital. His family then took him to KGMU. Rahul Awasthi died during treatment. Meanwhile, Rahul's maternal cousin Shivam said, "My brother got married around five years ago. He also has a four-year-old son." When we reached the trauma centre, the doctor declared Rahul dead. The police personnel who reached the scene merely watched the situation. They did not call an ambulance. During that time, our brother writhed in agony as blood continued to pour from his body. Meanwhile, we took Rahul to KGMU by auto-rickshaw for treatment.

stories.title: ‘If Iqra Hasan wants to marry, Hindu boys are ready’:BJP MLA's controversial statement in Saharanpur; SP MP had asked, ‘Am I not your daughter?’
stories.summary: BJP MLA Nand Kishore Gurjar made a major statement about Iqra Hasan, the Kairana MP from Saharanpur. He said that if Iqra was willing, they could arrange her marriage to a Hindu Gurjar boy. The Gurjar community had always considered her its daughter. If Iqra married a Hindu, they too would consider her their daughter. Gurjar, the Loni MLA from Ghaziabad, said that girls in their community were IAS officers, doctors and engineers as well. Nand Kishore reached Saharanpur at 5 pm on Saturday for the first foundation day of the Gau Raksha Dal. About a year ago, Iqra had asked members of the Gurjar community whether she was not their daughter. Read BJP MLA Nand Kishore's three major points... 1. Imran Masood changed his tune after Yogi became Chief Minister Nand Kishore Gurjar said that Imran Masood's tone had changed. "When there was no government, when Yogi ji was not there, what did he use to say? He used to talk about jihad and jihadists. Today, he has started talking about the law." I saw one of his videos in which he was openly threatening the people of Saharanpur. The youth of India is above the identity of any caste or community. He is a young man who carries the legacy of great figures such as Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, Maharana Pratap and Emperor Mihir Bhoj. We must move forward with this strength and unity. 2. Someone Else's Daughter Is Also My Daughter I want to tell the youth to recognise their strength like Bajrangbali, and for mothers to recognise their strength in the forms of Durga, Maa Shakumbhari and Chandi. The elderly should guide society. I am leaving with this message: this is the century of Sanatan. In the next 10 years, 70 per cent of the world's people will be Hindu. I have also spoken on the issue of halala, saying that if everyone understands that someone else's daughter is also my daughter, and that I should suffer just as much when something wrong happens to her, such practices will come to an end. 3. Cow Protection Is Every Hindu's Responsibility Cow protection is not the responsibility of any one organisation or individual. Every Sanatani will have to come forward to protect cows. In the past, even old cows were kept in villages as part of the family. Over time, this sentiment has weakened. MLA Gurjar also mentioned the Kairana exodus, the Muzaffarnagar riots and the law-and-order situation. Emphasising caste unity, he told members of the Gurjar, Jat, Saini, Pal and Kashyap communities that Hindu society should move forward as one family instead of being divided along caste lines. Iqra had asked, "Am I not a daughter of your community?" A year ago, Kairana MP Iqra Hasan had reached Chapar village in the Gangoh area of Saharanpur district. The village has a predominantly Gurjar population. In the presence of the villagers, she had become emotional and said, "I am being called a Mulli and a terrorist. Everyone has the right to protest, but the kind of language used against religions, communities and women during the protest is divisive and tears society apart. When I won the election, people from every religion and caste voted for me, considering me their daughter and sister. The abuse being hurled at me today is not just an insult to me but to every woman in this region. I have never practised the politics of religion or community. I have always tried to take everyone along. If anyone is unhappy with my work, they can replace me after five years. She asked whether she was not a daughter of their community.

stories.summary: UP CyberCrime Digital Fraud: साइबर अपराध के बढ़ते खतरे के बीच उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस ने डिजिटल तकनीक और त्वरित कार्रवाई के जरिए साइबर ठगी से होने वाले आर्थिक नुकसान को कम करने पर अपना फोकस बढ़ाया है। राज्य सरकार के अनुसार सितंबर में साइबर फ्रॉड की रकम फ्रीज कराने की प्रदेश की दर 34 प्रतिशत रही, जबकि राष्ट्रीय औसत 31 प्रतिशत दर्ज किया गया। साइबर ठगी की शिकायत मिलने के बाद रकम को तत्काल रोकने और उसे रिकवर कराने के लिए साइबर फ्रॉड मिटिगेशन सेंटर की भूमिका महत्वपूर्ण बताई जा रही है।प्रदेश में साइबर अपराध से निपटने की रणनीति केवल ठगी करने वालों तक कार्रवाई सीमित रखने के बजाय ठगी के बाद धनराशि के प्रवाह को रोकने पर भी केंद्रित है। रियल टाइम रूटिंग, बैंकिंग सिस्टम के साथ समन्वय और डिजिटल डेटा के इस्तेमाल के जरिए संदिग्ध लेनदेन की पहचान कर रकम को फ्रीज कराने की कोशिश की जा रही है। इससे साइबर अपराधियों को रकम एक खाते से दूसरे खाते में तेजी से स्थानांतरित करने से रोकने में मदद मिलने का दावा किया गया है।

stories.title: Umesh Pal murder accused found in Bihar jail:UP Police searched for him for 3 years; ₹5 lakh reward
stories.summary: The accused in the Umesh Pal murder case, Armaan, was lodged in Bihar's Gaya Central Jail on Saturday. The Uttar Pradesh Police had been searching for him since 2023 and had announced a ₹5 lakh reward for information leading to his arrest. He was a close associate and shooter of Atiq Ahmed. Armaan is originally from Gaya. After the Umesh Pal murder, he reportedly came to Gaya to evade the Uttar Pradesh Police. He had opened fire at ‘Bholu Anda Wale’ near Katari Pond, following which a case was registered against him. He later surrendered in court in the same case and was sent to Gaya Central Jail. The police of Prayagraj's Dhoomanganj police station have now received information that Armaan is lodged in Gaya Central Jail. Based on the information, the Uttar Pradesh Police reached Gayaji and identified Armaan after conducting an investigation. The Uttar Pradesh Police has subsequently filed an application in court seeking transit remand to take him with them. However, the Uttar Pradesh Police has not yet been granted transit remand. See 2 pictures of Atiq Ahmed gang shooter Armaan How did the Uttar Pradesh Police reach Armaan, who is lodged in Gaya jail? Uttar Pradesh Police continued searching for Arman. During this period, they received information that he was lodged in a jail in Gaya. Following this information, police from Prayagraj's Dhoomanganj police station reached Gaya Central Jail on 30 September. They took a recent photograph of Arman inside the jail and collected his thumb impressions on plain paper. Uttar Pradesh Police completed the paperwork and returned. The very next day, 1 October, they filed an application in the Gaya court seeking transit remand. However, the court did not hear the application for transit remand. Guddu Muslim's accomplice Arman was seen on CCTV On 24 February 2023, Umesh Pal and his two government security guards were shot dead in broad daylight in Prayagraj. At the time, CCTV footage clearly showed a man riding a motorcycle. The motorcycle was being ridden by Arman, a shooter from the Atiq Ahmed gang, while Guddu Muslim was seated behind him. Armaan was the one who brought Guddu Muslim to the scene on a motorcycle. As soon as he stopped the motorcycle, Guddu Muslim opened fire. Armaan also fired during the incident. After carrying out the crime, Armaan fled with his accomplice Guddu Muslim. Armaan's parents fear an encounter, appeal to court After learning that the Uttar Pradesh Police had become active and that Armaan would be taken to Uttar Pradesh on remand, his parents, Shamim and Asgari Khatoon, began fearing an encounter. Armaan's parents said, "Our son will be killed in an encounter as soon as he is taken to Uttar Pradesh." Arman's father has filed an application in the Gaya court seeking that Arman not be handed over to the Uttar Pradesh Police. If the Uttar Pradesh Police need to question him, they should do so via video conferencing. Arman's father, Shamim, said that the police have killed most of the accused in the Umesh Pal murder case in police encounters. The Uttar Pradesh Police could take Arman away and stage a fake encounter in the name of recovering weapons. Court rejects application by Arman's parents According to information, the Gaya court has rejected the application filed by Arman's parents. The Uttar Pradesh Police may now take Arman from Gaya jail to Prayagraj on transit remand at any time. The case was heard on 1 October in the court of Gaya magistrate Saurabh Kumar. The court rejected outright the application filed by Arman's family members and lawyer. Arman's lawyer, Lalit Kumar Gupta, has confirmed this. Arman's lawyer says-collusion between jail administration and police Armaan's lawyer, Lalit Kumar Gupta, has accused the police and prison authorities. He said Armaan's life is under a direct threat. Armaan could be killed in Uttar Pradesh. A conspiracy is being hatched to murder Mohammad Armaan in collusion with the Uttar Pradesh Police and the Gaya Central Jail authorities. He said, "We had sought a hearing through video conferencing in court, citing security concerns, but the court rejected it." He said Armaan has been lodged in Gaya jail since 27 February 2023. He is being deliberately framed in the Uttar Pradesh case. As soon as we receive a copy of the lower court's order, we will file a writ petition in the Patna High Court seeking protection for Armaan. Parents say: Our son is innocent, appeal to Yogi government for protection Armaan's parents, Shamim and Asgari Khatoon, said that their son was being made a scapegoat. Their family is very poor. They do not even have a permanent house of their own to live in. According to his parents, Armaan previously lived in Prayagraj and did odd jobs. He is neither a professional criminal nor a major shooter. He has been serving a prison sentence in connection with cases in Gaya for the past three years. They have appealed to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and the administration for security. Who Were the Accused in the Umesh Pal Murder Case? Current Status of the Shooters ​What happens next? ​The Uttar Pradesh Police is now preparing to take Armaan to Prayagraj without letting any opportunity slip. Armaan holds several hidden secrets about the Atiq gang and Guddu Muslim. If the Uttar Pradesh Police takes him on remand, it may also be able to trace Guddu Muslim's location. Meanwhile, Armaan's family is preparing to approach the Patna High Court.

stories.title: Swami Prasad Maurya meets Rahul Gandhi in Delhi:Party joins INDIA bloc; says, ‘We want Rahul as PM’
stories.summary: Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, former minister and Apni Janta Party president Swami Prasad Maurya met Congress MP Rahul Gandhi at around 12 pm on Saturday at 10 Janpath in New Delhi. After the meeting, Swami announced that his party would join the INDIA alliance. Speaking to the media, Swami Prasad said, “Apni Janta Party will now be part of the INDIA alliance. Our future strategy and the number of seats we will contest will be discussed later. We want Rahul Gandhi to become the country’s next prime minister.” 'The goal is to remove the BJP and save the Constitution' Swami said, "Our aim is to enter the electoral fray with the alliance: 'Remove the BJP, save the country' and 'Save the Constitution, remove the BJP'. Rahul Gandhi is raising the voice of the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and minorities across the country. Our party is also working on these issues in Uttar Pradesh. In view of our shared ideology, our party will contest the elections as part of the INDIA alliance." It may be noted that former MLAs Shyam Sundar Sharma, Rajiv Shukla, Rajendra Pal Gautam and Swami Prasad Maurya had reached 10 Janpath on Saturday. Earlier, Swami Prasad Maurya had left the Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) and joined the BJP. However, he resigned before the 2022 Assembly elections and joined the Samajwadi Party. Swami Prasad had previously served as Minister of Labour, Employment and Coordination in the Yogi government. "Crores of young people unemployed under the 'double-engine government'" Swami Prasad said, "Today, under the double-engine government, crores of young people are unemployed. Government jobs have stopped being available because of the government's wrong policies. Reservations for SCs, STs and OBCs have been rendered ineffective. Poverty is continuously increasing in the country. In a population of 140 crore, the lives of 80 crore people have been reduced to 5-10 kg of wheat and rice. Inflation is continuously rising." Despite being an agriculture-dependent country, farmers are not receiving remunerative prices. Government schools are continuously shutting down, with 10,000 schools on the verge of closure every year. Assets worth billions and trillions are being handed over to industrialists. We are already struggling to deal with these problems in Uttar Pradesh. But at the national level, the alternative is the Congress. UP Congress in-charge says: Many more people will join us Uttar Pradesh Congress in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam said, "Swami Prasad Maurya's party will work with us in the INDIA bloc in the 2027 Assembly election. After that, it will remain with us to form the government in the country under Rahul Gandhi's leadership in 2029 as well." A large number of parties have merged with the Congress. At least 50 parties have merged with the Congress so far. At least 50 small parties have extended their support to us. This process is continuing, and many more people will join in the future. Several prominent leaders are also joining us. On reports of talks about Swami Prasad Maurya's party merging with the Congress, Rajendra Pal Gautam said that no discussions had ever taken place on the matter. "A great deal is hidden in the womb of the future. What will happen in the future will be announced when the time comes." Swami formed a new party but failed to win Swami Prasad Maurya formed the Rashtriya Shoshit Samaj Party on February 22, 2024. The party contested the Lok Sabha elections, but all its candidates lost their deposits. Maurya contested from Kushinagar and finished fourth with 36,575 votes. His daughter Sanghamitra, a former BJP MP from Badaun, was also denied a ticket by the BJP in 2024.

stories.title: Former SP district chief slapped in Gorakhpur:Clash over sitting on chairs; fight breaks out at press conference
stories.summary: Former district president Nageena Sahani was slapped during a commotion over seating at the Samajwadi Party's press conference in Gorakhpur on Saturday. Supporters of Sahani and Anshuman Singh, who is seeking the party's nomination from the Rural Assembly seat, clashed with each other. The two sides first exchanged abuses, after which a physical fight broke out. During the clash, Kamlesh Singh, son of Anshuman Singh, slapped Sahani. Party office-bearers, a former elected representative and several SP workers were present at the time. Senior party leaders and workers intervened and separated the two sides. The situation later returned to normal. A video of the incident has also surfaced. The incident took place at around 2:45 p.m. in the auditorium of the Journalists Press Club at Shastri Chowk. Argument began over a chair SP district president Brijesh Gautam was holding a press conference about a programme being organised on the instructions of party national president Akhilesh Yadav. He was giving details about programmes under the ‘Save Democracy Week’ campaign, being held from October 2 to 8. During the press conference, Anshuman Singh arrived with some supporters. He said most of the chairs in the auditorium were occupied, while some space in the middle was vacant. Anshuman said he asked for a chair and requested Nageena Sahani to move slightly and sit to the side. Sahani refused to move, following which an argument broke out between the two sides. The argument soon turned into a scuffle. Anshuman said - a conspiracy to tarnish my image Anshuman Singh alleged that Nagina Sahni wanted to tarnish my image. I am seeking the party ticket from the same Assembly constituency for the 2027 election from which Nagina Sahni is also seeking the ticket. This is why the dispute is being given a political colour. Anshuman accused Nagina Sahni of using abusive language and speaking against the party's candidates. He said, "No abusive language was used by me." Speaking about the 2027 election, Anshuman said it would be an election for a change of government. He claimed that a wave of change was sweeping the state and that such incidents would have no impact on the Samajwadi Party. Nageena Sahni said - An attempt was made to forcibly vacate the chair Former Samajwadi Party district president Nageena Sahni alleged that Anshuman Singh arrived at the press conference with some people. Those who accompanied Anshuman Singh tried to forcibly vacate the chair. When they were asked to sit in the vacant space, those people began assaulting them. They said that I was abused and assaulted. Identifying himself as belonging to the fisherfolk-Nishad community, Nagina Sahani alleged that he was targeted because he was considered weak for this reason. Some people want to establish their dominance through hooliganism. Said Akhilesh Yadav will decide on the ticket Regarding his claim for the Chauri-Chaura seat in the 2027 election, Nagina Sahani said that national president Akhilesh Yadav would decide whom to give the ticket to. I have been seeking a ticket since 2012, but have not received one yet. Those who receive the party's ticket work for it. Everyone has the right to seek a ticket, but no one has the right to engage in violence or indiscipline. Some people had come to the press club with Anshuman Singh carrying illegal weapons. Journalists from the local to the national level were present at the press club, and bringing a weapon to such a place is a serious matter. I was threatened with death. When asked about filing a written complaint at the police station, they said that discussions would first be held with the party leaders. A decision on further action would be taken thereafter. SP district president says assault amounts to gross indiscipline SP district president Brijesh Kumar Gautam said that, on the instructions of national president Akhilesh Yadav, 'Save Democracy Week' was being observed from 2 to 8 October. A press conference had been called on Saturday as part of the programme. He said that Anshuman Singh had arrived at the press conference with some members of his family. He did not see what happened over the chair because he was presenting his views at the press conference at the time. A scuffle broke out during this. Brijesh Gautam described the incident as gross indiscipline. He said the matter would be brought to the attention of national president Akhilesh Yadav. Further action would be taken according to the decision of the national leadership. On Anshuman Singh's claim that he had been personally invited to the press conference, the district president said that was not the case. He said all senior leaders had been informed and invited through the group. Kajal Nishad said - The incident was highly condemnable SP leader Kajal Nishad said that a 'Save Democracy Week' was being observed over the issue of votes being deleted in the name of SIR. At a meeting of the INDIA alliance in New Delhi on 30 September, it had been decided to run the campaign from 2 to 8 October. She said that as part of the campaign, a press conference was held on Saturday under the leadership of the district president. Nageena Sahni was sitting beside her at the time. Her attention was focused on the district president when an argument began over the chair. Kajal Nishad said that Nagina Sahni had told her that a woman was sitting beside her and there was no space there. This was followed by verbal abuse and a scuffle. She described the incident as highly condemnable. During elections, every leader and party worker has the right to seek a ticket and prepare to contest the election, but there should be no disputes or animosity among them.

stories.title: 15 IAS, 23 PCS officers transferred in UP:Amit Singh removed after Rajbhar expressed displeasure, Mala Srivastava’s role downgraded
stories.summary: The Yogi government transferred 15 IAS and 23 PCS officers on Saturday. Jaunpur Chief Development Officer (CDO) Dhruv Khadia has been appointed CDO of Mau. Mau CDO Vivek Kumar Srivastava has been given charge as Member (Judicial) at the Board of Revenue in Prayagraj. Narendra Bahadur Singh has been appointed CDO of Jaunpur. He was earlier serving as ADM (Finance and Revenue) in Lakhimpur Kheri. Amit Kumar Singh has been transferred from Director, Panchayati Raj, and appointed Managing Director of PCDF. Prakash Bindu has been transferred from Managing Director, PCDF, and appointed Secretary, Medical Education. Dr Ujjwal Kumar has been transferred from Managing Director, Uttar Pradesh Medical Supply Corporation, and appointed Special Secretary and Director, Geology and Mining. J. Reebha has been transferred from Special Secretary, Geology and Mining, and appointed Managing Director of the Uttar Pradesh Medical Supply Corporation. See the complete list of IAS transfers: See the complete list of PCS transfers : Ramji Mishra made Lucknow ADM, Pushpendra Patel made Rampur ADM The Uttar Pradesh government has transferred several PCS officers, including those at the levels of Additional District Magistrate (ADM), Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and Additional Municipal Commissioner. Some officers have been kept on waiting until they receive new postings. Ramji Mishra has been transferred from Deputy Director, Uttar Pradesh State Agricultural Produce Market Council, and appointed ADM (Finance and Revenue), Lucknow. Shivani Singh has been transferred from the Revenue Council in Lucknow and appointed ADM (Namami Gange and Rural Water Supply), Jalaun. Chandra Kumar has been transferred from ADM (Judicial), Sant Kabir Nagar, and appointed Chief Revenue Officer, Deoria. Jitendra Vikram has been transferred from SDM, Lalitpur, and appointed ADM (Judicial), Sant Kabir Nagar. Lavi Tripathi has been transferred from Additional Municipal Commissioner, Meerut, and appointed ADM (Administration), Saharanpur. Rajesh Kumar has been transferred from SDM, Siddharthnagar, and appointed Additional Municipal Commissioner, Meerut. Pushpendra Patel has been transferred from SDM, Amethi, and appointed ADM (Administration), Rampur. stories.title: Akhilesh gives ticket to man who removed BJP flag:Sanjayan Tripathi met him yesterday; SP suddenly changes 2 MLC candidates
stories.summary: Before the upcoming Legislative Council (MLC) elections in Uttar Pradesh, the Samajwadi Party has changed two of its candidates on Saturday. SP has withdrawn the ticket of Ram Prakash Gupta, who was earlier announced as its candidate from the Agra division. He has been replaced by Akash Agrawal, the outgoing teachers' MLC who recently joined the party. The party leadership decided to field Akash Agrawal because of his strong support among teachers and at the local level. Along with Agra, the party has also changed its candidate in the Gorakhpur-Faizabad division. The party has now announced Dr Sanjay Tripathi as its new candidate in place of Kamlesh Yadav, who had been declared the candidate earlier. Election equations recalibrated by changing candidates The Samajwadi Party's new strategy is being cited as the reason behind the sudden replacement of candidates in both important constituencies. Through this reshuffle just before the election, the Samajwadi Party has tried to recalibrate the regional and social equations. Party workers hope that the arrival of the new candidates will make the contest in these constituencies highly interesting and more competitive.

stories.title: Man jumps from 43rd floor of Noida’s tallest building:Body shattered in fall | VIDEO
stories.summary: A youth died after jumping from the 43rd floor of a building in residential society on in Noida on Saturday. The incident took place at Aspire Tower in Supernova Society in Sector 94, Noida, on Saturday afternoon. He died on the spot due to the impact of the fall. A loud sound was heard when he hit the ground. The incident caused panic in the society. After receiving information, police reached the spot and started an investigation. Police are trying to identify the youth. During the initial investigation, it came to light that he had jumped from the 43rd floor of the tower. Police checked the area around the spot and started collecting information about the youth's identity and other details related to the incident. They are also trying to find out whether he lived in the society or had come there for some work. A live video related to the incident has also reportedly surfaced. Police are checking the video and other evidence found at the spot as part of the investigation. Check out the visuals below : Read the full story below : According to police, Sambhav, son of Vinay Kumar Jain and a resident of the IMT Manesar area of Gurugram, rented room number 4228 in the building on October 2. He checked in at around 2:30 pm. At 11:27 am on Saturday, Sambhav climbed onto the balcony and started hanging outside. AC technicians working in the nearby room, 4227, saw him and came outside. They tried to talk him into coming back inside. Sambhav told them that he was under severe depression and did not want to live. He then jumped from the balcony. After receiving information, police from the Sector-126 police station reached the spot and started an investigation. The police collected the body from the ground and sent it for post-mortem. During the investigation, police found that Sambhav had recorded a video before the incident. In the video, he reportedly mentioned financial problems and said he wanted to end his life. Police have sent the video for examination. Police also found WhatsApp chats between Sambhav and his father on his phone, in which he had also written about suicide.

stories.title: Yogi says 50,000 girls will soon get scooters:₹4.60 lakh students got scholarships; says, ‘Don’t spend it on gutkha-chaat’
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said on Saturday that the state government would soon provide scooters to 50,000 girl students. The scheme is aimed at helping meritorious girls studying in graduation courses. Speaking at an event, Yogi said the Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana provides ₹25,000 to girls for their education from birth to graduation. He also said tablets were being given to 2 crore young people. Yogi criticised the previous government, saying, “Anyone who thinks only about his family cannot think about the state.” He said Uttar Pradesh had earlier faced problems related to riots, jobs and the safety of women, but claimed that the situation had changed. Appealing to students, he said they should not waste their scholarship money on chaat or gutka. He asked them to use the money for their studies, buy good books and make their first investment in a good book. Earlier, at 10 am, Yogi transferred more than ₹148 crore in scholarships and fee reimbursements directly to the bank accounts of over 4.60 lakh students at Lok Bhavan. The transfer was confirmed in reports on Saturday. Panchayati Raj Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar, Social Welfare Minister Asim Arun, Backward Classes Welfare Minister Narendra Kashyap and Minister of State Sanjeev Gond were also present at the event. Key points from Yogi's address Yogi: Many ministers became leaders after missing scholarships Yogi said leaders like Om Prakash Rajbhar and Sanjeev Kumar Gond struggled without timely scholarships and later became ministers. Aseem Arun became an IPS officer and later a minister. He said sincere effort brings results. Before 2017, SC-ST scholarship money was not reaching students Yogi said scholarships were not properly given to SC-ST students before 2017 and alleged the money was misused. After coming to power, his government paid two years’ scholarships together. Scholarship money will reach students on time Yogi said scholarships will be sent to students’ bank accounts after admission. He directed departments to ensure no child is left out and said a portal was launched after data for 4 lakh SC-ST children was missing. UP Board exams now finish in 15 days Yogi said schools earlier faced teacher shortages, poor buildings and high dropout rates. He said the government has improved education, with board exams now held within 15 days and results declared within a month. Jobs for 1 lakh young people in six months Yogi said 10 lakh young people have received government jobs so far. He said preparations are underway to provide jobs to another 1 lakh young people in the next six months. No curfew or riots in UP now: Yogi Yogi said Uttar Pradesh has moved forward and there are no curfews or riots now. He urged students to work hard and contribute to making India a developed country by 2047.

stories.title: Woman constable had affair with coaching owner 23 years older:Over 5,000 calls in 9 months; found hanging
stories.summary: A teacher was arrested in Kanpur after a 22-year-old female constable hanged herself to death after allegedly being mentally harassed on Saturday. Police said constable Pratiksha Singh, was in a relationship with the married coaching teacher, who was 23 years older than her. Call records showed that the two had spoken around 5,000 times in the past nine months. Their longest call lasted nearly four hours. Pratiksha’s father told police that the teacher was mentally troubling his daughter. Police identified the accused as Vikram Singh Chandel. He will be produced in court today before being sent to jail. DCP South Dipendra Nath Chaudhary said the constable had started talking to someone else some time ago, which led to a dispute between her and the teacher. He said the two spoke three times on the day of the incident. The body of 22-year-old woman constable Pratiksha Singh, who was posted at Amethi's Mohanganj police station, was found hanging at her home in the Reuna police station area of Kanpur. South DCP Deependra Nath Chaudhary said that in 2022, the woman constable had joined the coaching centre in Gajner run by Vikram Singh Chandel, a resident of Vinour village in Sachendi. The two began speaking some time later. In 2025, the woman was recruited as a police constable. She was subsequently posted at Mohanganj police station in Amethi. She had come home in the Reuna police station area on Wednesday, 30 September, after taking seven days' leave. As soon as she reached home, she said she wanted to rest and went to her room on the terrace. At around 2 p.m., her younger sister entered the room and saw her hanging from a noose. Her younger sister called their mother and father. The police and forensic team that reached the scene investigated and found that the constable's mobile phone had been reset. The affair was with a father of two On the complaint filed by Constable Pratiksha's father, Vijay Singh, police registered a case against 45-year-old coaching centre operator Vikram Singh Chandel under sections related to abetment to suicide. South DCP Dipendra Nath Chaudhary said, “Vikram is married and has two children. He was having an affair with a female constable. An examination of the constable's call detail records revealed that she had spoken to Vikram more than 5,000 times between January and September. The longest call lasted four hours.” He spoke to the Amethi constable before the suicide According to DCP Dipendra Nath Chaudhary, the female constable began talking to someone else after joining, and Vikram came to know about it. The two also quarrelled over the matter. On the day of the suicide, 30 September, Vikram and the female constable, Pratiksha, spoke three times. They spoke for about 30 minutes in the morning, then for 15 minutes at 11 am, and finally for around 45 minutes between approximately 2 p.m. and 3 p.m. After this, the female constable spoke to the constable posted in Amethi for around 30 to 35 minutes. The constable then reset his mobile phone and died by suicide. Teacher used to visit her home posing as her brother The DCP said the family members told police that the coaching teacher considered Prateeksha his sister and used to visit her home posing as her brother. During police questioning, teacher Vikram said that his family wanted to arrange his marriage, and the two had spoken about the matter at length that day. Family accused police officers of harassment The deceased woman's father, Vijay Singh, also alleged that she was being continuously subjected to mental harassment by a departmental colleague while on duty in Mohanganj. She was repeatedly threatened that her career and life would be ruined. He also alleged that police officers harassed her over assigning duties, granting leave and at her workplace. According to the father, whenever his daughter came home, she appeared frightened and withdrawn. He tried several times to ask her about it, but she refused to tell him.
