Astronomers spot gas falling onto a neutron star, revealing how matter reaches its surface
stories.summary: On February 1, 2025, a research team used the XRISM telescope to study GX 301–2. They captured a unique event of gas falling onto a neutron star. The observations revealed changes in iron absorption lines from redshift to emission over time. The study suggests multi-phase accretion and indicates interactions with the stellar wind. These findings provide new insights into how neutron stars feed on surrounding matter.

The findings support the species’ first appearance in southern Africa at that time and provide evidence of microevolution inP. robustus.

stories.title: Vijay's TVK joins INDIA bloc meet in Tamil Nadu, Congress calls it 'historic day'
stories.summary: Manickam Tagore, the president of the Tamil Nadu Congress Committee, celebrated the significant inclusion of Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam in the INDIA alliance. The assembly was pivotal in calling for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar due to discrepancies in electoral rolls. Notable participants, Aadhav Arjuna and Maria Wilson, emphasized the urgency of the issue, with protests planned across Tamil Nadu to amplify their demand for accountability.

stories.title: How a US pest-control effort turned Asian lady beetles into an invasive species
stories.summary: Originally imported to the United States for biological pest control, the multicoloured Asian lady beetle, or Harmonia axyridis, has turned invasive. Competing with native ladybugs, this species disrupts ecosystems. While it helps manage aphid populations, its autumn behavior drives adult beetles to invade homes, creating an unwanted nuisance. This case serves as a cautionary tale about the unintended effects of introducing nonnative species into local environments.

stories.title: 'Most comprehensive plan': Ukraine confirms India playing role in mediating energy truce in Black Sea
stories.summary: Ukraine has expressed readiness to explore India's comprehensive proposal for ending the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict. During recent communications, Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha emphasized the importance of India's mediation role. India's external affairs minister S Jaishankar affirmed continuous engagement with both Kyiv and Moscow regarding potential solutions. Ukraine is open to discussing limited ceasefire arrangements around energy infrastructure and safe Black Sea shipping.

A Moroccan mine built a road from phosphate waste rock; field tests cut dust emissions by 91%

This robust, three-layered pavement design not only successfully supports heavy mining vehicles but also helps manage dust emissions effectively. Testing resulted in a notable decrease in airborne dust and enhanced road quality, with an anticipated 15 percent boost in productivity for mining operations, while also cutting down maintenance expenses.

stories.summary: After her time at Cincinnati Children's Hospital, Payton Obert initiated a lemonade stand to assist children in distress. What started as a simple venture has evolved into Payton's Lemonade Stand, amassing over $5 million for various children's charities. The nonprofit not only supplies toys and necessary items to kids facing illness but also encourages community participation, proving that even small gestures can spark tremendous positive impacts.

stories.summary: Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta has reported significant progress in waste management at landfill sites throughout the city. The government has successfully reclaimed land and aims to eliminate existing garbage mountains while managing fresh waste effectively. New waste processing facilities have been inaugurated at Okhla, Ghazipur, and Singhola, each designed to process thousands of metric tonnes daily.

stories.title: Muskegon Lake had 347,350 tons of debris and 190,000 tons of contaminated soil removed
stories.summary: Muskegon Lake in Michigan has been officially delisted from the EPA's Areas of Concern list, marking a monumental milestone in restoration efforts. Over decades, key initiatives addressed challenges such as habitat degradation, pollution in soils, and shoreline hardening. With around $80 million dedicated to the cause, revitalized wetland habitats now support thriving fish and wildlife communities. This achievement heralds a brighter future for both the environment and local residents.

stories.title: Texas family has owned a 650-acre Lake Palestine ranch since 1940; a $10 million deal will turn the property into a new state park

Acquired by the Texas Parks and Wildlife Foundation from the long-time Pollard family, this land has a rich history dating back to 1940. The park’s development will proceed in stages, initially offering guided access before introducing more facilities for visitors.

This mission was executed based on critical intelligence that pinpointed various militant hideouts. Alongside this successful strike, the forces seized a substantial arsenal of weapons and ammunition. This action is a response to the recent surge in violence linked to the TTP, emphasizing the military's ongoing commitment to combatting terrorism in the region.

stories.title: Shopper’s C$5 thrift-store painting turns out to be a David Bowie original, sells for C$108,120
stories.summary: A lucky shopper stumbled upon a remarkable David Bowie painting at a donation center, priced at just C$5. After expert verification, it was revealed to be D Head XLVI from Bowie's iconic Dead Heads series. Shockingly, the artwork was auctioned for an astounding C$108,120, setting a record for Bowie's art. In the 1970s, an Italian priest sold 12,000 piranhas to Europe; 55 years later his proceeds have funded 350m bridges and an 800m airstrip
stories.summary: Giovanni Gallo, an Italian Jesuit priest, moved to Marajó Island in Brazil in the 1970s. He organized the preservation and export of 12,000 piranhas to fund community infrastructure projects. These projects included bridges, a cemetery, a dock, and an airstrip for local residents. Gallo also founded the Museu do Marajó, which showcased local history and archaeology.

stories.title: 658 unmarked graves found at two remote Australian cemeteries after specialist search
stories.summary: A groundbreaking project has identified 658 previously unmarked graves at the White Cliffs and Menindee cemeteries in Australia. Utilizing advanced non-invasive scanning techniques, Hunter Geophysics successfully located these burial sites, ensuring no disturbance to the ground. This initiative aims to enhance cemetery management and heritage conservation, with plans for memorialization at White Cliffs for those honored. stories.summary: The historic Bel-Air estate once owned by Judy Garland has been sold for $11.1 million, slightly below its listing price of $11.495 million. Built in 1938 by the renowned architect Wallace Neff, this traditional-style home showcases five bedrooms and seven bathrooms, set amid lush surroundings. stories.title: 81 years after British submarine sank Nazi U-boat, Norway faces mercury threat from its wreck
stories.summary: Norwegian authorities are grappling with a serious mercury contamination issue stemming from the sunken U-864 submarine, which met its fate during World War II. Recent investigations discovered leaking mercury containers, prompting worries about environmental repercussions. The government is now exploring strategies to mitigate this contamination, with sealing the wreck being one of the options under consideration by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries in Norway.

stories.title: A Florida owner planned 52 homesites on his 625-acre ranch; county agrees to pay $7.8 million to stop development
stories.summary: In a bid to safeguard a crucial ecological area, Collier County has finalized an agreement to buy Wildflowerz Ranch, preventing any residential construction on its expansive 625 acres. Valued at approximately $7.8 million after two years of negotiations, this acquisition underscores the county's dedication to conservation and wildlife protection. Additionally, the ranch's current cattle operations will remain intact under a lease that lasts until the end of 2027.

stories.summary: Priyanka Kakkar, a former Aam Aadmi Party spokesperson, joined the Congress party after leaving AAP. Kakkar also expressed admiration for Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's resilience in facing political challenges and supported his criticisms of the Chief Election Commissioner.

John Denver guest house gets fixes; buyer sells for $8.2M

The recent buyer undertook significant renovations, including a modern kitchen and structural improvements. This property spans 5 acres within a gated community and offers stunning views from Aspen to Snowmass. It consists of two structures totaling 2,912 square feet, including a guest house that served as Denver's studio.

stories.title: Two Iranians in UK charged over terror plot targeting Manchester’s Jewish community
stories.summary: In a grave development, two Iranian nationals, Rahman Salehi and Salam Ahmadyan, face charges in the UK over an alleged terror conspiracy targeting Manchester's Jewish community during Yom Kippur. They stand accused of carrying out reconnaissance and attempting to procure materials for an improvised explosive device. Prompt intervention by authorities on September 20 thwarted the plot, ensuring the safety of the community from any imminent danger.

stories.title: Tribunal Lets £76m Claim Proceed: ex-Gitpod VP wins disability case; payout still undecided
stories.summary: Shannon Burns is currently involved in a significant legal battle against Gitpod regarding her employment termination. She has won a disability discrimination case, but compensation has not yet been awarded. Burns is seeking £76 million, arguing her dismissal disrupted her technology career. A tribunal recently allowed her claim to proceed despite Gitpod's attempts to limit it.

stories.title: $9.99 thrift-store painting was meant for cat art; it sold for $34,375 at Sotheby’s

In 2019, a family moved a 255-year-old mansion 50 miles by barge to a new home
stories.summary: A 255-year-old mansion, Galloway House, was moved by a Maryland family to prevent it from being demolished. The structure traveled approximately 50 miles across the Chesapeake Bay after extensive planning and specialized equipment. Crews lifted the 400-ton house for a phased relocation that began in September 2019. After arriving at its new waterfront property in Queenstown, restoration efforts commenced to preserve its historic character.

Rob Scheer started Comfort Cases in 2013; it has given 300,000+ backpacks to foster kids
stories.summary: Comfort Cases, founded by Rob Scheer in 2013, helps provide essential items for children entering foster care. After experiencing the trauma of carrying trash bags, Scheer initiated a movement to change this narrative. The organization has distributed over 300,000 bags across multiple regions, including the US and the UK. It continually collaborates with community organizations to reach children in need effectively.

Effort to bring back the rapids of Grand Rapids that disappeared after industrial development
stories.summary: After nearly two decades of planning, construction is underway in downtown Grand Rapids to restore the historic rapids that gave the city its name. The first phase will remove four low-head dams and replace them with natural rock features designed to improve fish passage, habitat and river access. The project also includes measures to protect mussels and control invasive sea lampreys.

Iowa farmer says $25,000 wind lease is his farm's most profitable income source
stories.summary: In Iowa, a farmer discovered that collaborating with wind turbine projects resulted in a steadier income stream than conventional farming. This innovative approach combats the unpredictability of commodity prices and rising operational expenses. Numerous Midwestern farmers embrace this strategy, leading to sustainable financial growth. Wind energy initiatives also bolster local economies via enhanced tax revenues and infrastructure upgrades, demonstrating resilience despite some community pushback.

stories.title: UK-Iranian man arrested with link to security incident at US-run RAF Fairford base in England
stories.summary: A UK-Iranian dual national was arrested in London over a security incident linked to RAF Fairford. The incident followed the arrest of five British men suspected of preparing a terrorist act. Authorities are investigating potential foreign state involvement, particularly from Iran, which has denied any connection. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has indicated strong signs suggesting Iran's role in the incident.

He emphasized the importance of preventing the use of weapons of mass destruction in international disputes. stories.title: 17 Indian fishermen rescued by Seychelles, India expresses gratitude
stories.summary: India's Ministry of External Affairs has praised Seychelles for its rapid response in rescuing 17 Indian fishermen from the distressed fishing vessel IFB Sajira, which faced engine troubles amid turbulent waters. This incident underscores the enduring camaraderie between the two nations and their shared dedication to safeguarding citizens at sea. The swift rescue operation exemplifies international solidarity in critical situations.

American artist traded a painting and $10 for 153 acres in 1882; farm later became a landscape devoted to art
stories.summary: In 1882, Julian Alden Weir purchased a farm in Connecticut that transformed into his home and creative workspace. Initially focused on portraits and still life, he later immersed himself in the surrounding landscape. His shift towards Impressionism inspired numerous visiting artists. Today, the site is known as Weir Farm National Historical Park, preserving its artistic heritage with a collection of over 300 works reflecting American Impressionism.

Originally priced at $9.45 million, the listing underwent several adjustments before finding a buyer. The penthouse is noted for its expansive layout and a sizable terrace, with celebrity appeal enhanced by Keanu Reeves' previous rental. Evangelista has since moved to a new apartment nearby, staying within New York's vibrant real estate scene.
